# NECSUS European Journal of Media Studies

> > A scholarly journal exploring media studies, film, television, and digital culture across European and global contexts.

NECSUS publishes peer-reviewed academic articles, reviews, and multimedia content examining contemporary media phenomena, historical events in broadcasting and film, and critical perspectives on media technology and culture. The journal bridges theoretical analysis with cultural documentation.

## Key Topics

- Media Studies
- Film History
- Television Studies
- Digital Culture
- Historical Events
- Documentary Production
- Cultural Heritage
- Broadcasting History
- Media Technology
- Academic Publishing
- Peer Review
- European Media
- Visual Culture
- Archival Research

## Historical Archives & Daily Features

- [On This Day - Today in History, Film, Music and Sport](https://onthisday.com): Homepage featuring historical events, birthdays, deaths from 4000 BC to today

## Documentary & Film Production

- [Call for Proposals: "The Protectors" A Documentary Series by Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/page/call-for-proposals-the-protectors-a-documentary-series-by-scientific-american): Film proposal call for wildlife conservation documentaries, $80K funding

- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm.](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Subscription plans page offering digital and print access to SciAm content
